meta.title: How Bacteria Eat Plastic Like Pac-Man! 🦠🍽️
meta.description: Scientists at the University of Konstanz discovered a revolutionary 'Pac-Man enzyme' in soil bacteria that devours plastic in under a year while also cleaving penicillin antibiotics! Here is the first-principles technical breakdown. #Science #Biotech #PlasticPollution #Microbiology #Shorts
facts_to_verify: How Bacteria Eat Plastic Like Pac-Man operates via distributed synchronized state machines.
misconceptions: Bacteria can now eat all ordinary plastic bags and water bottles; conventional polyethylene (HDPE) lacks ester bonds and remains 100% resistant.
Microbes decompose plastic by swallowing whole pieces; they use surface-anchored depolymerase enzymes that bore tiny cavities into the material.
Plastic-eating and antibiotic resistance are unrelated; this enzyme shares structural homology with beta-lactamases, proving deep evolutionary links.
meta.analogy: Like a microscopic Pac-Man anchored to a bacterial submarine chomping through chemical beads on a polymer necklace, turning tough plastic into bite-sized nutrients.
